# pco's programs for an `if` lowered as a branch (pco_cf.c lower_if_cond_exec,
# pco's PCO_DEBUG=no_pred_cf), read by tests/usc_limits.rs
# a_predicable_if_branches_as_pcos_no_pred_cf_does (gl_test 195 ifbranch).
# Each is the blend variant 0x98661 (femtovg's one,inv_src_alpha) of a source
# of gl_test 193/195, as the table's toolchain builds it with predication off:
#
#   PCO_DEBUG=no_pred_cf yakogl-tools glsl2usc -o out.rs --blend one,inv_src_alpha \
#     tools/shaders/femtovg/fill_color.nodiscard.frag \
#     tools/shaders/offarm/fill_color.nodiscard.offarm{8,32,128}.frag
#
# toolchain: pco_shc=f537fc86b41f glslang=9e007f4bf514 (src/shaderc/blobs.rs's;
# without PCO_DEBUG the same command gives the table's 0x98661 rows byte for byte)
#
# Each record is the table row's for the same source and key but for its
# length and temporaries (the uniform rows the same), so the table row's
# uniforms place its inputs.
#
# program <source> sha256=<the source text's> dw=<words> temps=<temporaries>,
# then the words, eight a line
